text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To uncover the mystery behind the
treasure map
left by a younger
Matikanefukukitaru and her
sister, we
visit her house—a shrine.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nineteen, twenty! Where I'm standing is
twenty
steps from the shrine's bell!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: There are ants here!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Uh... Wait a moment... I think there was

something we had to do here... Oh!
choice_data_list: う、うーん、特に何もないかな……

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without another word, she grabs a
shovel and
quickly starts digging.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Look! A piece of paper with a code was
buried
here!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bravo! A code, you say? What a
delightful turn of
events!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "en b." Hm... All right, let's keep going!
choice_data_list: それで、なんて書いてあるんだ？
それで、なんて書いてある？

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The kagura hall... How nostalgic. My
sister always
looked so pretty in the
traditional dance clothing.
I'd play in
front of the mirror trying to copy her

makeup.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see, in that case... Haaah ha ha!
Behold, I've
found it! Behind the mirror...
"ox"!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Flower ornament... Um... Could it be the
vase
over there?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm thinking it's this hanging scroll.
My sister
actually painted this one
herself. That's why I
think behind it,
there'll be—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It says, "wo." ...My sister was always so
earnest,
able to do anything she set her
mind to. I can only
imagine her smile as
she hid these clues...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Look at all the carp! And your
garden's
huuuge!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's probably another memory of my
sister I need
to recall.
choice_data_list: 暗号を隠せそうな場所がないけど……

text_block_list.name: Young Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Look, Sister! There's something written
on the
back of that big fish!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gasp! I remembered! Look for the biggest carp in the pond! There should be a snippet of the code written on its back!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
We already have "en b" from the bell
and "ox"
from the kagura hall!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The hanging scroll of flowers gave us
"wo," and
finally, from the shining back
of that great carp,
we have "od."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let me take it from here! Now if I just
rearrange
the pieces...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's gotta be referring to this box,
then! One,
two, three—heave!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh wow! Such a pretty kimono! Is this
the
treasure?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This kimono... I remember now! That's
right... this
is—

text_block_list.name: Young Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Awww! I'm so jealous of the kimono you
got from
Mom! I wanna try it on!

text_block_list.name: Fukukitaru's Sister
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'd love to see you wear it
someday too!

text_block_list.name: Fukukitaru's Sister
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know. I'll draw a treasure map just
for you!
So when you get bigger, you
can go on a search
for it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
So this is where it was hidden. A
treasure... just for
me.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Fuku, there's something on the
ground! It
looks like a letter?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Dear Fuku, you're an adult now! Congratulations! I love how you're always so happy and full of energy! Thinking of you always!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, Sis!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I wanted you to see me... wearing this
too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. I've made up my mind!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
One day, I'm going to gain enough
happiness so
I'll look great in this
celebratory kimono!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And on some ultra-lucky, ultra-special
occasion,
I'll wear it for myself and my
sister!
...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel a presence somewhere behind me.
A
tingling sensation, like the warmth of
springtime
sun.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, once we're bigger, let's get photos
taken
with everyone wearing kimonos!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that is a splendid idea! I'll dress up
so
beautifully as to put even faeries to
shame!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Taking photos together sounds great!
Oh, um,
that's only if you're okay with it,
Fukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... I'll do my best, for her too!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, your sister didn't go to these
lengths only
to see you cry. Show her
your best smile!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha! Ehehe, that's so silly!
Come on,
you guys do it too!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ha... h-haaah ah ha!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're right. I'll raise my voice
beyond the
clouds!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Inhale... NYAAAH HA HA HA!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wiping the tears from her face,

Matikanefukukitaru laughs with all her
heart as
she embraces life with the
happiness and energy
her sister loved so
much.
